{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing age sentinel)
valid_ages = data[data['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print the mean age and the count of valid ages
print(f"Mean age: {mean_age}")
print(f"Number of valid ages: {len(valid_ages)}")"}
